data.desc: Detroit-based Rocket Mortgage (NMLS #3030) is the nation's largest mortgage lender and a part of Rocket Companies (NYSE: RKT). The lender enables the American Dream of homeownership and financial freedom through its obsession with an industry-leading, digital-driven client experience. In late 2015, it introduced the first fully digital, completely online mortgage experience. Since its founding in 1985, Rocket Mortgage has closed more than $2.1 trillion of mortgage volume across all 50 states. Rocket Companies, Rocket Mortgage's parent company, has placed in the top third of Fortune's list of the '100 Best Companies to Work For' the list for 23 consecutive years.
